title: Favorites with a real frontend and backend
intent: Let two simulated demo identities manage persistent favorites through an accessible web interface and a real local HTTP API.

criteria.description: Adding a favorite through the interface persists it in the backend and survives reloading the page.
criteria.given: Alice has no favorites and the local demo server is running.
criteria.when: Alice adds Sourdough toast to favorites and reloads the page.
criteria.then: The interface and the real favorites API both contain Sourdough toast exactly once. The backend stores the change in its configured data file.

criteria.description: Removing a favorite updates the backend and survives reloading the page.
criteria.given: Alice has Sourdough toast saved as a favorite.
criteria.when: Alice removes Sourdough toast through the interface and reloads the page.
criteria.then: Sourdough toast is absent from Alice's favorites in the interface and in the real favorites API.

criteria.description: Repeated and concurrent additions are idempotent.
criteria.when: Three real API requests add Sourdough toast concurrently and another request adds it again.
criteria.then: Every addition succeeds and Alice has exactly one Sourdough toast favorite in the API and interface.

criteria.description: Favorites remain isolated between two explicitly simulated demo identities.
criteria.given: Alice and Bob each have no favorites. The identity selector is a demo mechanism, not authentication.
criteria.when: Alice adds Sourdough toast and Bob adds Green salad through the interface.
criteria.then: Alice sees only Sourdough toast and Bob sees only Green salad in their respective interface views and real API responses. This proves demo data partitioning, not authorization security.

criteria.description: Invalid mutations return an error without changing either identity's favorites.
criteria.given: Alice has Sourdough toast and Bob has no favorites.
criteria.when: Real API requests attempt to add an unknown item or mutate favorites with an unknown or missing demo identity.
criteria.then: Each invalid request returns HTTP 400 and both identities' favorites remain unchanged.
